newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers unchanged on Japanese holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers unchanged on Japanese holiday.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes on Monday were little moved from Friday amid a quiet market with Japan closed for a holiday, brokes said.
Bunker cst 180 was quoted at $125 per tonne with cst 380 at $122 by both majors and independents, they said.
"We had only one vessel fixed at $122 per tonne for 380 cst," a shipowner said.
Supplies appear adequate to meet demand but prices would fluctuate with cargo levels, said a trader.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $220--$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
